intro.title: Hello, I'm Xun Keran
intro.desc:
Robotics competition builder, working on whole-robot structure and embedded control.
R&D and on-field debugging for RoboMaster and the China Engineering Robot Competition.
Interested in omnidirectional chassis, mechanism design, and motion control.

item0.title: RoboMaster 2025 Competition Robot (No. 1)
item0.desc: Robot No. 1 built for RoboMaster 2025. A four-wheel omnidirectional chassis with independent per-wheel drive carries a heavy large-angle pitch mechanism on top, wrapped in mesh armor and LED armor plates. Frame, support arms, and every 3D-printed part were designed in-house, and the harness is layered by module and bundled inside the frame so armor and ballast can be swapped for each rule revision. Photographed at the 2025 National Finals.

item1.title: RoboMaster Infantry Robots (No. 3 / 4)
item1.desc: Two robots from a dual-infantry build: a four-wheel mecanum chassis, a gimbal that rotates a full turn, and a 17 mm launcher with magazine and laser aiming aid, with guard tubes and quick-release plates on both sides of the barrel; orange 3D-printed parts act as magazine rails and cable anchors. The pair ran the field under armor plates 3 and 4, and the white balls on the floor are spent 17 mm projectiles.

item2.title: Multi-Servo Arm Control System
item2.desc: The servo control system designed in-house for our 2025 China Engineering Robot Competition entry. An STM32 board sits at the center, fanning multiple PWM channels out to joint-numbered servo headers, backed by 20 kg-class digital servos, direct LiPo power, and a buck module. Harnesses are numbered and bundled in sections, and power runs through an XT60 connector with a pull-guard label, so any joint can be found fast during assembly and post-match repair.

item3.title: Omnidirectional Suspended-Chassis Combat Robot
item3.desc: A combat platform built around mobility: four mecanum wheels handle drive, small idler wheels at the corners prevent tip-over, and the upper assembly floats on springs and linear rails so it self-levels over obstacles and uneven patches. The top module pitches independently, harnesses leave the frame in braided sleeves, and the head keeps mounting points for a camera and video transmitter. Armor and lighting are cut to regulation sizes, with structure and electronics modularized on a single frame.

event11.title: Internship at Qianxing Intelligence
event11.desc: Working as a motion-control algorithm engineer across multiple humanoid platforms, covering motion retargeting, mjlab-based hierarchical policy training, hardware debugging, and visual self-occlusion preprocessing.

event13.title: G-Exo and the Physical AI Hackathon
event13.desc: Led full-system development of a four-DOF active lower-limb exoskeleton and won the alloop track at the inaugural Physical AI Hackathon.

event14.title: S-Dog Quadruped Robot
event14.desc: Deployed RL locomotion policies for obstacle crossing, platform climbing, and self-recovery on hardware, and exhibited the project at WAIC 2026.

event10.title: Launched LocoWiki Resource Hub
event10.desc: Launched the LocoWiki resource hub for robot competition preparation, research learning, and development reference, bringing together competition rules, technical sharing, paper reading lists, and high-quality open-source projects in one place.

event12.title: Launched OpenDoge Open-Source Quadruped Crowdfunding
event12.desc: Initiated the OpenDoge crowdfunding project as a founding developer, leading locomotion-policy training, sim-to-real deployment, and hardware adaptation.

event1.title: Open-Sourced SliverWolf Desktop Serial-Link Quadruped
event1.desc: Released SliverWolf, a desktop serial-link quadruped robot featuring voice control and robotic-arm collaboration.

event2.title: 2024 ROBOCON National Competition
event2.desc: Developed the embedded control system for the R1 robot based on FreeRTOS, achieving ±5mm positioning accuracy, ball launching, and gripper functionalities.

event4.title: Fujian Intelligent Marine Equipment Design Competition
event4.desc: Led control-system development for a buoyancy-controllable multi-DOF lobster-inspired underwater robot, winning the Grand Prize.

event5.title: 2024 World Marine Equipment Conference
event5.desc: Represented Fujian University of Technology as an exhibitor, showcasing the bionic lobster robot; covered by media outlets including Xinhua News Agency.

event6.title: 2025 ROBOCON National Competition
event6.desc: Responsible for full-stack R&D of the legged robot. Ranked 30th nationally in the Speed Race, 31st in the Obstacle Race, and 34th in the Cross-Country Race, securing National Second Prize in all three categories.

event7.title: 2025 National Undergraduate Electronics Design Contest
event7.desc: Responsible for the hardware design and fabrication of the power meter for an automatic ranging system, winning the National Second Prize.

event8.title: Open-Sourced BRS Parallel-Link Quadruped Robot
event8.desc: Open-sourced the mechanical structure and control code of the BRS parallel-link quadruped robot on GitHub.

event9.title: Internship at HighTorque Robotics
event9.desc: Worked as a motion-control algorithm intern, leading a mini open-source quadruped project and moving modules from prototype validation toward productization.
